our_interpretation: The numerical claim concerns paying users as a share of active users, rather than the percentage of a tracked cohort that purchases a subscription.
The surrounding paragraph supplies a numerator of 20 million consumer subscribers plus five million business users. Adding those groups requires checking for overlap and consistent definitions.

Because the claim describes an ongoing state, the target is the latest available snapshot in the current calendar quarter through publication, July 1–August 25, 2025. This does not make counts from different dates interchangeable.
The monthly-user figures are explicitly guesses. Their arithmetic implication can be checked separately from whether they describe actual usage.
The descriptions mediocre and terrible are value judgments and are not graded.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Matched counts establish a materially different weekly paid share or a monthly paid share of at least 3%. Arithmetic can contradict the implication of the guessed denominator without establishing the actual monthly share.
